verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-facing control for opting out of telemetry or usage tracking. The closest item is an enterprise option to keep organization data out of AI model training, arranged through an account manager. That is an adjacent data-use control, not a telemetry opt-out, and admin usage analytics are a different feature again.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
